records.observation: Standalone static diagnostic using low-level clog2.InputLog. main requires one filename else exit0, opens input then times createDefs/createPrimitives, closes only normal completion, prints int claimed byte total and durations. Static initializer creates reusable record instances. createDefs resets category/map/color state, constructs arrow definition width3 and exact Header/Msg reflection methods, inserts category by sequential index. Combines known/user undefined state lists but no solo definitions. For EACH state it looks up Topo_State matchStartEvent/matchFinalEvent with Header/RecBare; actual class methods are Header/RecCargo, so first state causes NoSuchMethodException then exit1. createPrimitives dynamic new-state lookup repeats same wrong signature. This static linkage defect is diagnostic-only; normal ContentIterator uses correct handler factories. If no initial states, stateform can remain null; end-statistics dereference then fails absent later assignment. Record loop handles state definitions: new registration uses wrong signature, existing matching target updates name/color only (not format); mismatched targets log. Skips event definitions3, constants4, collective8, communicator9, source10,time-shift11; no event topology or ID map/YCoordMap construction. Bare/cargo/msg read and reflectively invoke mapped handlers with Header and null/cargo/msg, ignore etype-1, print/count non-null primitive immediately; IllegalAccess/InvocationTarget log/continue, direct NPE logs/exits1. Unknown type logs without body resync, zero read results not rejected, counters signed int and unchecked. Type1 advances block, type0 null stream; same truncated-block EOF behavior inherited. End unmatched arrow count uses arrow queue, state count ONLY current static stateform (not aggregate over all state categories); removes null-name categories from objdefs before printing. List indices then no longer equal category index. No sorting/time-order checks, output file or independent integrity assurance. Conditions after signature-failure paths described conditionally, not claimed executed.
